description:
# TLDRSEC AI API Documentation

## Response Structure

All SEC filing API responses follow this structure:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "metadata": {
    "ticker": "AAPL",
    "cik": "0000320193",
    "company": "Apple Inc.",
    "requestTimestamp": "2025-05-31T09:06:45.000Z",
    "filingCount": 3,
    "processedCount": 3,
    "aiProvider": "Claude",
    "aiModel": "claude-3-opus-20240229",
    "cacheInfo": {
      "size": 5,
      "maxSize": 100,
      "cacheHits": 2
    }
  },
  "usage": {
    "totalRequests": 3,
    "totalTokens": 12500,
    "estimatedCost": 0.25
  },
  "results": [
    {
      "filingType": "10-K",
      "filingDate": "2024-10-28",
      "filingUrl": "https://www.sec.gov/...",
      "analysis": {
        "summary": "Annual report showing strong financial performance...",
        "keyMetrics": [...],
        "importantDisclosures": [...],
        "risks": [...],
        "sentiment": "positive"
      },
      "cacheHit": true
    }
  ]
}
```

## Cache Optimization

The API uses intelligent caching to reduce Claude API costs:

1. **Document Hashing**: Each filing is hashed based on content and metadata
2. **In-Memory Cache**: Analysis results are stored in memory
3. **Cache Statistics**: Monitor cache performance in the response metadata
4. **Cost Reduction**: Subsequent requests for the same filings avoid redundant AI calls
